purpose: Establishes a canonical, reproducible Git source for the live Scheduler bundle, which until MX-APPT-5002 existed only as a mutable, unversioned CDN object with no source repository and no identified publisher (MX-APPT-5000 tier 3 / MX-APPT-5001 B-1).

adoption.method: byte-exact adoption of the observed production artifact
adoption.note: No upstream source repository or publisher was ever found. This adoption makes the observed production bytes the source of record. It does NOT claim to recover an original author's source.

paired_adapter.note: The adapter applies byte-exact patches to this bundle at runtime. Editing the canonical source WILL invalidate patches that target the edited text. Always re-run _SYSTEM/tools/scheduler_patch_audit.mjs after changing the source.

invariants: The adopted artifact is the baseline. Any change to LIVE/scheduler/scheduler_v1.html must be a reviewed commit on top of the adoption commit, never a re-adoption that silently overwrites lineage.
LIVE/scheduler/scheduler_v1.html is an ALIAS target. Every publish must also write an immutable content-hashed version under versions/.
Never publish without pre- and post-publish hash verification.
Never publish a source whose patch audit reports a FAIL on a required adapter patch.
This lock does not authorize deployment. Deployment requires separate, explicit approval.

history.note: Byte-exact adoption of live production artifact. Functionally identical by construction; no edits.
